about: The MilkDrop presets the scenes use (T6.1.2). `source` is the preset's name in the butterchurn-presets package (1754 presets), which carries its author; `pnpm ambient-presets` copies each one to static/data/ambient/<id>.json. Chosen from a sweep of all 1754 rendered with the recording's audio (pnpm ambient-curate), then by eye, then re-measured over 20 s at three places in the recording: mean luminance 0.04 to 0.27 of full scale, no flashing (at most 0.3 frames in a second jump by more than 0.1), nothing sharp-edged and bright.

blue-mountains.mood: calm, night, a lake under stars
blue-mountains.why: The silent gaps between pieces: nothing to cover, so it can be the most picture-like.

underwater-cathedral.why: Contrapunctus I to IV, the plain fugues: stone arches, no colour to compete with the voices.

night-forest.why: Contrapunctus V: darker and more restless than the first four, still nearly black.

jellyfish-dance.why: The ribbon pieces (VI, VII): flowing shapes that echo the wavy notes.

hyperspace.why: VIII to XI colour the notes by theme; a grey background leaves the colours alone.

golden-mirror.why: XII and XIII, rectus and inversus: a picture that is its own reflection.

stormy-sea.mood: open, dark sky over rough water
stormy-sea.why: The unfinished fugue (XIV): a horizon and nothing above it; fades out with the ending.

escape.why: The canons: lines receding to a point, one voice following another.
